segments.text: Meet your floating Token Guardian, using synthetic preview data.
A small champion keeps your usage summary nearby. Pin the widget above other windows.
Summon the butler to inspect the trail, understand the largest recorded session, and review suggested next steps.
Ask in the floating chat. Local explanations stay on this computer. OpenAI and DeepSeek are optional.
Choose Ahri, Jinx, or Jhin, then try a cozy outfit. Collect good habits, without spending more tokens.
The full dashboard opens in a separate window, while your companion stays nearby.
For voice input, open the dashboard in your browser. The native window keeps microphone access off.
Dismiss the butler or hide the widget. You can return from the app menu whenever you want.
Use the desktop setup script, then launch Token Guardian. The Mac source launcher needs no Xcode. This prototype is unsigned.
